description: Image pins live in TypeScript; .tektonic/ is synthesized from it. Renovate only ever saw the output — the Ansible manager matches any tasks/*.yaml, so .tektonic/tasks/*.k8s.yaml was rewritten by accident of the path while the source that generates it stayed behind, and the next `tektonic synth` would have reverted the bump.

This manager puts the pins themselves under Renovate. Renovate cannot run the generator, though — postUpgradeTasks is self-hosted only — so the bump alone would leave .tektonic/ behind. The renovate-synth GitHub Actions workflow re-synthesizes and commits onto the same branch, so both sides of a bump land on one branch; the check-manifests step in the self-CI test-npm task fails the build if they ever disagree.
config:recommended ignores examples/ by default, which is why ignorePaths is spelled out here without it.
Add a file when it grows a versioned image literal. Unversioned tags (base:stable) are left alone by the leading digit required of currentValue.

One PR for every CI image pin, not one per image. Each bump has to carry the .tektonic/ manifests regenerated from it (the renovate-synth workflow does that), and a manifest re-synth touches whichever tasks use the image — so separate PRs for nodejs and syft both rewrite test-npm.k8s.yaml and anchore-scan.k8s.yaml and conflict with each other the moment one merges. Grouped, the synth runs once over the final set of pins.

separateMajorMinor is off for the same reason: these images are all built from the same apko-cicd repo and are reviewed together, and a split major PR would be a second branch racing the minor one over the same generated files.
